title: Route provider no-seat responses to the capacity workflow

outcomes.statement: A classified provider no-seat response atomically enters the existing blocked-no-seat capacity workflow while other failures remain distinct.
outcomes.demo: Return a provider no-seat response and verify one legal blocked_no_seat transition, no failed transition, and visibility to capacity recovery.

uncertainties.statement: US-063 must first establish the invitation execution seam that this classification extends.
uncertainties.resolution: US-063 is dev_done at source commit 2263bee9009a8e6716e68963a43f56e2880c87d3 and establishes the automated invitation worker, durable connector-call observation, advisory-lock recovery, and atomic success-finalization seams that US-064 extends.
